# Repository instructions

This repository contains multiple projects. For changes under `karlolegend-desktop/**`, use `karlolegend-desktop/AI_CONTEXT.md` as the compact canonical product/architecture context and follow `karlolegend-desktop/AGENTS.md`.

Do not apply KARLOLEGEND Desktop assumptions to unrelated site files.

For KARLOLEGEND source changes, preserve plain-filesystem interoperability, update documentation/changelog when behavior changes, and rely on the Windows GitHub Actions release build as the authoritative compilation check.
